title: GTA6 Insights: Rockstar Devs Originally Thought GTA Online Would Fail
description: As anticipation builds for GTA6, a former Rockstar Games developer reveals that the team was completely sure GTA Online would flop before launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Surprising Origins of GTA Online: A Rockstar Developer's Revelation

As anticipation for **GTA6** continues to reach unprecedented heights across the global gaming community, a fascinating piece of industry history has surfaced. According to a recent report by IGN Games, a former Rockstar Games developer has revealed that before its initial launch, the team was completely positive that **GTA Online** was going to fail.

Today, GTA Online stands as one of the most commercially successful and enduring multiplayer experiences in video game history, generating massive revenue and maintaining a dedicated player base for years. However, according to this insider perspective, the mood inside the studio prior to release was far from confident. The developers harbored deep doubts about whether a traditionally single-player focused open-world franchise could successfully transition into a persistent online service model.

## What This Means for the Future of GTA6

While the source did not provide specific details regarding upcoming titles, this historical insight offers an interesting context for the development of GTA6 and its anticipated online ecosystem. Industry analysts suggest that facing internal skepticism is not unusual for groundbreaking projects, and Rockstar's past experience with overcoming extreme self-doubt during the creation of GTA Online could shape how they handle modern multiplayer innovations.

As fans eagerly await official updates from Rockstar Games regarding GTA6, this revelation serves as a reminder that the most unpredictable projects can sometimes yield the most monumental successes in gaming.

## Editor's Take
It is fascinating to learn that even a powerhouse like Rockstar Games had deep internal doubts about GTA Online before it launched. Knowing that the team once expected the project to flop makes its historic success and massive longevity even more remarkable, adding an intriguing layer of context as we look ahead to GTA6.
